题目内容: 【例题 28】设总体 $X \sim N(\mu_{1},4)$ , $Y \sim N(\mu_{2},5)$ , X 与 Y 相互独立. $X_{1},\cdots,X_{8}$ 和 $Y_{1},\cdots,Y_{10}$ 是分别来自总体 X 和 Y 的两个样本, $S_{X}^{2}$ 与 $S_{Y}^{2}$ 分别为两个样本的方差, 则（）.

章节: 第六章 统计量分布与数字特征
题型: 题型四 双正态总体的抽样分布
题目内容:
【例题 29】 $X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}$ 为总体 $N\left(\mu_{1}, \sigma^{2}\right)$ 的简单随机样本, $Y_{1}, Y_{2}, \cdots, Y_{m}$ 为总体 $N\left(\mu_{2}, 2\sigma^{2}\right)$ 的简单随机样本, 两样本独立, 令

$$
\overline {{{X}}} = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i}, \overline {{{Y}}} = \frac {1}{m} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} Y _ {i}, S _ {1} ^ {2} = \frac {1}{n - 1} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(X _ {i} - \overline {{{X}}}\right) ^ {2}, S _ {2} ^ {2} = \frac {1}{m - 1} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} \left(Y _ {i} - \overline {{{Y}}}\right) ^ {2},
$$

则（）.
解析:
答案 (D)
解析 本题考查对双正态总体抽样分布的理解.

根据正态总体的性质可知，

$$
\frac {(n - 1) S _ {1} ^ {2}}{\sigma^ {2}} \sim \chi^ {2} (n - 1),
$$

$$
\frac {(m - 1) S _ {2} ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sim \chi^ {2} (m - 1).
$$

由 $S_{1}^{2}, S_{2}^{2}$ 的独立性可得，

$$
F = \frac {\frac {(n - 1) S _ {1} ^ {2}}{\sigma^ {2}} \bigg / (n - 1)}{\frac {(m - 1) S _ {2} ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \bigg / (m - 1)} \sim F (n - 1, m - 1),
$$

即 $F = 2\frac{S_1^2}{S_2^2}\sim F(n - 1,m - 1).$

选(D).

章节: 第六章 统计量分布与数字特征
题型: 题型四 双正态总体的抽样分布
解析:
答案 $t(2)$
解析 本题考查对双正态总体抽样分布的理解.

不妨设 $X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^{2})$ , $Y_{1}$ 可视作样本子集 $X_{1}, \cdots, X_{6}$ 的样本均值; $Y_{2}$ 可视作样本子集 $X_{7}, X_{8}, X_{9}$ 的样本均值, 则 $Y_{1} \sim N\left(\mu, \frac{\sigma^{2}}{6}\right)$ , $Y_{2} \sim N\left(\mu, \frac{\sigma^{2}}{3}\right)$ .

由 $Y_{1}, Y_{2}$ 独立性可知， $Y_{1} - Y_{2} \sim N\left(0, \frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\right), S^{2} = \frac{1}{3 - 1} \sum_{i=7}^{9} \left(X_{i} - \frac{X_{7} + X_{8} + X_{9}}{3}\right)^{2}$ 可视作样本子集 $X_{7}, X_{8}, X_{9}$ 的样本方差，则

$$
\frac {2 S ^ {2}}{\sigma^ {2}} \sim \chi^ {2} (3 - 1) = \chi^ {2} (2).
$$

由样本均值与样本方差的独立性可知，

$$
Z = \frac {\frac {Y _ {1} - Y _ {2} - 0}{\sqrt {\frac {\sigma^ {2}}{2}}}}{\sqrt {\frac {2 S ^ {2}}{\sigma^ {2}}} \Bigg / 2} \sim t (2),
$$

即 $Z = \sqrt{2}\frac{Y_1 - Y_2}{S}\sim t(2).$

章节: 第七章 参数估计
题型: 题型一 点估计及估计量的数字特征
解析:
解析 本题考查离散型随机变量的点估计.

(1) 由 $E(X)=2(1-\theta)$ ，以及 $P(X=2)=(1-\theta)^{2}$ 得 $2(1-\theta)=P(X=0)\cdot0+P(X=1)\cdot1+P(X=2)\cdot2=P(X=1)+2(1-\theta)^{2}.$ 从而

$$
P (X = 1) = 2 (1 - \theta) - 2 (1 - \theta) ^ {2} = 2 \theta (1 - \theta),
$$

$$
P (X = 0) = 1 - P (X = 1) - P (X = 2) = 1 - 2 \theta (1 - \theta) - (1 - \theta) ^ {2} = \theta^ {2},
$$

于是 $X$ 的分布律为

$$
\begin{array}{c c c c} X & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ \hline P & \theta^ {2} & 2 \theta (1 - \theta) & (1 - \theta) ^ {2} \end{array}
$$

(2) 由 $E(X) = 2(1 - \theta)$ , 根据矩估计定义, 令 $E(X) = \overline{X} = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} X_i$ , 得 $2(1 - \theta) = \overline{X}$ , 从而 $\theta = 1 - \frac{\overline{X}}{2}$ , 于是 $\theta$ 的矩估计量为 $\hat{\theta}_1 = 1 - \frac{\overline{X}}{2}$ . 又 $E(\hat{\theta}_1) = E\left(1 - \frac{\overline{X}}{2}\right) = 1 - \frac{1}{2} E(\overline{X}) = 1 - \frac{1}{2} E(X) = 1 - \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2(1 - \theta) = \theta$ , 从而 $\hat{\theta}_1 = 1 - \frac{\overline{X}}{2}$ 为 $\theta$ 的无偏估计量 (即 $E(\hat{\theta}_1) = \theta$ ).

(3) 当样本值为 2, 1, 2, 0, 2, 0, 1, 2 时，由 X 的分布律可得 $\theta$ 的似然函数为

$$
\begin{array}{r l} L (\theta) & = [ P (X = 2) ] ^ {4} [ P (X = 1) ] ^ {2} [ P (X = 0) ] ^ {2} \\ & = [ (1 - \theta) ^ {2} ] ^ {4} [ 2 \theta (1 - \theta) ] ^ {2} (\theta^ {2}) ^ {2} \\ & = 4 \theta^ {6} (1 - \theta) ^ {1 0}; \end{array}
$$

取对数: $\ln L(\theta)=\ln 4+6\ln \theta+10\ln(1-\theta)$ ;

求导: $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\theta)}{\mathrm{d}\theta}=\frac{6}{\theta}-\frac{10}{1-\theta}$ ，并令 $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\theta)}{\mathrm{d}\theta}=0$ 得 $\theta=\frac{3}{8}$ .

于是, $\theta$ 的最大似然估计值为 $\hat{\theta}=\frac{3}{8}$ .

章节: 第七章 参数估计
题型: 题型一 点估计及估计量的数字特征
题目内容:
【例题 2】设 X 服从参数为 $\lambda$ 的泊松分布, $X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}$ 是来自 X 的一个简单随机样本.

(1) 求 $\lambda$ 的最大似然估计量; (2) 求 $\lambda^{2}$ 的最大似然估计量.
解析:
解析 本题考查离散型泊松分布的最大似然估计.

(1) 设 $x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{n}$ 为 $X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}$ 的样本值，由 $P(X = k) = \frac{\mathrm{e}^{-\lambda} \lambda^{k}}{k!}, k = 0, 1, 2, \cdots$ ，得似然函数为

$$
L (\lambda) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- \lambda} \lambda^ {x _ {i}}}{x _ {i} !} = (\mathrm{e} ^ {- \lambda}) ^ {n} \lambda^ {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x _ {i}} \cdot \frac {1}{x _ {1} ! \cdot x _ {2} ! \cdot \cdots \cdot x _ {n} !};
$$

取对数: $\ln L(\lambda) = -n\lambda + \left( \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_{i} \right) \ln \lambda - \ln (x_{i}! \cdot x_{2}! \cdot \cdots \cdot x_{n}!)$ ;

求导: $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\lambda)}{\mathrm{d}\lambda}=-n+\frac{1}{\lambda}\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_{i}$ ，令 $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\lambda)}{\mathrm{d}\lambda}=0$ ，得 $\lambda=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_{i}$ .

于是， $\lambda$ 的最大似然估计量为 $\hat{\lambda} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}X_i = \overline{X}$ .

(2) 由最大似然估计的不变性, 得 $\lambda^2 = (\hat{\lambda})^2 = \overline{X}^2$ .

章节: 第七章 参数估计
题型: 题型一 点估计及估计量的数字特征
解析:
解析 本题考查连续型总体的最大似然估计以及估计量的数字特征.

(1) 设 $x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{n}$ 为 $X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}$ 的样本值，则 $\sigma$ 的似然函数为

$$
L (\sigma) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f (x _ {i}; \sigma) = \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {n} \left(\frac {1}{\sigma}\right) ^ {n} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{\sigma} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} | x _ {i} |};
$$

取对数: $\ln L(\sigma) = -n\ln 2 - n\ln \sigma - \frac{1}{\sigma} \sum_{i=1}^{n} |x_i|$ ;

求导： $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\sigma)}{\mathrm{d}\sigma} = -\frac{n}{\sigma} +\frac{1}{\sigma^2}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}|x_i|$ .令 $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\sigma)}{\mathrm{d}\sigma} = 0$ ，得 $\sigma = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}|x_i|$

于是， $\sigma$ 的最大似然估计量为 $\hat{\sigma} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}|X_i|$ .

(2)

$$
\begin{array}{r l} E (\hat {\sigma}) & = E \left(\frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} | X _ {i} |\right) = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} E (| X _ {i} |) = E (| X |) \\ & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} | x | f (x; \sigma) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} | x | \cdot \frac {1}{2 \sigma} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {| x |}{\sigma}} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot \frac {1}{\sigma} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x}{\sigma}} \mathrm{d} x, \end{array}
$$

其中 $\frac{1}{\sigma}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{x}{\sigma}}$ 可视作 $E\left(\frac{1}{\sigma}\right)$ 的概率密度，故 $\int_0^{+\infty}x\cdot \frac{1}{\sigma}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{x}{\sigma}}\mathrm{d}x$ 为 $E\left(\frac{1}{\sigma}\right)$ 对应数学期望，值为 $\sigma$

$$
\begin{array}{r l} D (\hat {\sigma}) & = D \left[ \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} | X _ {i} | \right] = \frac {1}{n} D | X | \\ & = \frac {1}{n} \left[ E (X ^ {2}) - (E | X |) ^ {2} \right], \end{array}
$$

其中 $E(X^2) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\frac{x^2}{2\sigma}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{|x|}{\sigma}}\mathrm{d}x = \int_{0}^{+\infty}\frac{x^2}{\sigma}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{x}{\sigma}}\mathrm{d}x,\frac{1}{\sigma}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{x}{\sigma}}$ 可以视作 $E\left(\frac{1}{\sigma}\right)$ 对应的概率密度， $\int_0^{+\infty}\frac{x^2}{\sigma}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{x}{\sigma}}\mathrm{d}x$ 即视作 $T\sim E\left(\frac{1}{\sigma}\right)$ 时 $T^2$ 的数学期望，即 $E(T^2) = [E(T)]^2 +D(T) =$ $\left(\frac{1}{1 / \sigma}\right)^2 +\frac{1}{(1 / \sigma)^2} = 2\sigma^2$ ，故 $D(\hat{\sigma}) = \frac{1}{n}(2\sigma^2 -\sigma^2) = \frac{\sigma^2}{n}.$

章节: 第七章 参数估计
题型: 题型一 点估计及估计量的数字特征
题目内容:
【例题 4】设某种元件的使用寿命 X 的概率密度为 $f(x;\theta)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&2\mathrm{e}^{-2(x-\theta)},&x\geq\theta,\\ &0,&x<\theta,\end{aligned}\right.$ 其中 $\theta>0$ 为未知参数。又设 $x_{1},x_{2},\cdots,x_{n}$ 是 X 的一组样本观测值。

（1）求 $\theta$ 的矩估计和最大似然估计 $\hat{\theta}$ ；

(2) 求 $E(\hat{\theta})$ .
解析:
解析 本题考查连续型总体的点估计以及估计量的数字特征.

(1)

$$
E (X) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x; \theta) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {\theta} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 (x - \theta)} \mathrm{d} x,
$$

利用换元法，令 $x - \theta = t$ ，则

$$
E (X) = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} (\theta + t) \cdot 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 t} \mathrm{d} t.
$$

上式可看作 $T \sim E(2)$ 条件下 $\theta + T$ 的期望，即 $E(X) = E(\theta + T) = \theta + E(T) = \theta + \frac{1}{2}$ .

令 $E(X) = \overline{X}$ , 得 $\frac{1}{2} + \theta = \overline{X}, \theta = \overline{X} - \frac{1}{2}$ , 于是 $\theta$ 的矩估计量为 $\hat{\theta}' = \overline{X} - \frac{1}{2}$ .

当样本值 $x_{1}, x_{1}, \cdots, x_{n}$ 满足 $x_{i} \geqslant \theta$ 时， $\theta$ 的似然函数为

$$
L (\theta) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f (x _ {i}; \theta) = 2 ^ {n} \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (x _ {i} - \theta)} = 2 ^ {n} \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 (\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x _ {i} - n \theta)};
$$

取对数: $\ln L(\theta)=n\ln2-2\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_{i}-n\theta\right)=n\ln2-2\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_{i}+2n\theta;$

求导: $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\theta)}{\mathrm{d}\theta} = 2n > 0$ , 即 $\ln L(\theta)$ 关于 $\theta$ 单增. 又 $x_{i} \geqslant \theta$ , 即 $\theta \leqslant \min\{x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{n}\}$ .

于是， $\theta$ 的最大似然估计量 $\hat{\theta} = \min\{X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}\}$ .

(2) 由 $f(x; \theta) = \begin{cases} 2\mathrm{e}^{-2(x - \theta)}, & x \geqslant \theta, \\ 0, & x \leqslant \theta \end{cases}$ 得 $X$ 的分布函数

$$
F (x) = P (X \leqslant x) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {x} f (t; \theta) \mathrm{d} t = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 (x - \theta)}, & x \geqslant \theta , \\ 0, & x <   \theta , \end{array} \right.
$$

于是 $\hat{\theta}=\min\{X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}\}$ 的分布函数为

$$
F _ {\theta} (x) = 1 - [ 1 - F (x) ] ^ {n} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 n (x - \theta)}, & x \geqslant \theta , \\ 0, & x <   \theta . \end{array} \right.
$$

故 $\hat{\theta}$ 的概率密度函数为

$$
f _ {\theta} (x) = [ F _ {\theta} (x) ] ^ {\prime} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 2 n \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 n (x - \theta)}, & x > \theta , \\ 0, & \text {其它}. \end{array} \right.
$$

于是

$$
E (\hat {\theta}) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f _ {\hat {\theta}} (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {\theta} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot 2 n \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 n (x - \theta)} \mathrm{d} x
$$

$$
\frac {\text {令} x - \theta = t}{\int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} (\theta + t) \cdot 2 n \mathrm{e} ^ {- 2 n t} \mathrm{d} t},
$$

上式为 $T \sim E(2n)$ 时 $\theta + T$ 的期望，即 $E(\theta + T) = \theta + ET = \theta + \frac{1}{2n}$ .

综上， $E(\hat{\theta}) = \theta +\frac{1}{2n}.$

章节: 第七章 参数估计
题型: 题型一 点估计及估计量的数字特征
题目内容:
【例题 5】设二维随机变量 $(X,Y)$ 的概率密度为 $f(x,y)=\frac{1}{2\pi\sigma^{2}}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{2\sigma^{2}}},(x,y)\in R^{2},\sigma>0$ ，记 $Z=\sqrt{X^{2}+Y^{2}}$ ，若 $Z_{1},Z_{2},\cdots,Z_{n}$ 为来自总体Z的简单随机样本.

(1) 求 $\sigma^{2}$ 的最大似然估计量 $\sigma^{2}$ .

(2) 求 $E\sigma^{2}$ .
解析:
解析 本题考查二维随机变量的最大似然估计以及估计量的数字特征.

(1) 根据分布函数的定义, 可知 $Z = \sqrt{X^{2} + Y^{2}}$ 的分布函数为

$$
F _ {Z} (z) = P (\sqrt {X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2}} \leqslant z) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant z ^ {2}} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y, & z \geqslant 0, \\ 0, & z <   0. \end{array} \right.
$$

当 $z \geqslant 0$ 时，

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant z ^ {2}} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y & = \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {z} \frac {1}{2 \pi \sigma^ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {r ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \cdot r \mathrm{d} r = 2 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {z} \frac {1}{2 \pi \sigma^ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {r ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \cdot r \mathrm{d} r \\ & = \int_ {0} ^ {z} \frac {1}{\sigma^ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {r ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \cdot r \mathrm{d} r. \end{array}
$$

于是, $Z=\sqrt{X^{2}+Y^{2}}$ 的概率密度函数为

$$
f (z; \sigma^ {2}) = [ F _ {Z} (z) ] ^ {\prime} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{\sigma^ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \cdot z, & z > 0, \\ 0, & z \leqslant 0. \end{array} \right.
$$

设 $z_{1}, z_{2}, \cdots, z_{n}$ 为 $Z_{1}, Z_{2}, \cdots, Z_{n}$ 的样本值，当 $z_{i} > 0 (i = 1, 2, \cdots, n)$ 时， $\sigma^{2}$ 的似然函数为

$$
L (\sigma^ {2}) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f (z _ {i}; \sigma^ {2}) = (\sigma^ {2}) ^ {- n} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} z _ {i} ^ {2}} (z _ {1} z _ {2} \dots z _ {n});
$$

取对数： $\ln L(\sigma^2) = -n\ln \sigma^2 -\frac{1}{2\sigma^2}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}z_i^2 +\sum_{i = 1}^{n}\ln z_i.$

求导： $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\sigma^2)}{\mathrm{d}\sigma^2} = -\frac{n}{\sigma^2} +\frac{1}{2\sigma^4}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}z_i^2$ ，令 $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\sigma^2)}{\mathrm{d}\sigma^2} = 0$ ，得 $\sigma^2 = \frac{1}{2n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}z_i^2;$

于是， $\sigma^2$ 的最大似然估计量为 $\hat{\sigma^2} = \frac{1}{2n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}Z_i^2$ .

$$
E (\widehat {\sigma^ {2}}) = E \left(\frac {1}{2 n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} Z _ {i} ^ {2}\right) = \frac {1}{2 n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} E (Z _ {i} ^ {2}) = \frac {1}{2} E (Z ^ {2}),\tag{2}
$$

$$
E (Z ^ {2}) = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} z ^ {2} \cdot \frac {1}{\sigma^ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \cdot z \mathrm{d} z,
$$

令 $\frac{z^2}{2\sigma^2} = t$ ，则 $\frac{z}{\sigma^2}\mathrm{d}z = \mathrm{d}t$ ，故

$$
E (Z ^ {2}) = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} 2 \sigma^ {2} t \mathrm{e} ^ {- t} \mathrm{d} t = 2 \sigma^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} t \mathrm{e} ^ {- t} \mathrm{d} t,
$$

将 $\int_{0}^{+\infty} t \mathrm{e}^{-t} \mathrm{d}t$ 看成 $T \sim E(1)$ 条件下 $T$ 的数学期望，其值为 1，故 $E(Z^2) = 2\sigma^2, E(\hat{\sigma^2}) = \frac{1}{2} E(Z^2) = \sigma^2$ .

章节: 第七章 参数估计
题型: 题型一 点估计及估计量的数字特征
题目内容: 【例题6】设随机变量 $X$ 服从正态分布 $N(1, \sigma^2)$ 入 $X_1, X_2, \cdots, X_n$ 为来自总体 $X$ 的简单随机样本，记 $\sigma^2$ 为 $\sigma^2$ 的最大似然估计量， $\hat{\sigma}$ 为 $\sigma$ 的最大似然估计量，则下列结论中，正确的是（）.
解析:
答案 (C)
解析 本题考查正态分布 $\sigma^2$ 与 $\sigma$ 最大似然估计量的期望与方差. 由 $X \sim N(1, \sigma^2)$ 得 $X$ 的概率密度函数为

$$
f (x; \sigma^ {2}) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {(x - 1) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}}.
$$

设 $x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{n}$ 为 $X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}$ 的样本值，则似然函数为

$$
L = \left[ (2 \pi) ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \right] ^ {n} (\sigma^ {- 1}) ^ {n} e ^ {- \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (x _ {i} - 1) ^ {2}}.
$$

估计 $\sigma^{2}$ 时, $L=L(\sigma^{2})$ , 取对数:

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \ln L (\sigma^ {2}) & = - \frac {n}{2} \ln (2 \pi) - n \ln \sigma - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (x _ {i} - 1) ^ {2} \\ & = - \frac {n}{2} \ln (2 \pi) - \frac {n \ln \sigma^ {2}}{2} - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (x _ {i} - 1) ^ {2}; \end{array}
$$

求导： $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\sigma^2)}{\mathrm{d}\sigma^2} = -\frac{n}{2}\frac{1}{\sigma^2} +\frac{1}{2\sigma^4}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}(x_i - 1)^2.$ 令 $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\sigma^2)}{\mathrm{d}\sigma^2} = 0$ ，得 $\hat{\sigma}^2 = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}(X_i - 1)^2.$

估计 $\sigma$ 时， $L = L(\sigma)$ ，取对数

$$
\ln L (\sigma) = - \frac {n}{2} \ln (2 \pi) - n \ln \sigma - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (x _ {i} - 1) ^ {2};
$$

求导： $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\sigma)}{\mathrm{d}\sigma} = -\frac{n}{\sigma} +\frac{1}{\sigma^3}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}(x_i - 1)^2.$ 令 $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln(\sigma)}{\mathrm{d}\sigma} = 0$ 得 $\hat{\sigma} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}(X_i - 1)^2}.$

于是， $\hat{\sigma^2} = (\hat{\sigma})^2$ ，从而

$$
E (\hat {\sigma^ {2}}) - [ E (\hat {\sigma}) ] ^ {2} = E [ (\hat {\sigma}) ^ {2} ] - [ E (\hat {\sigma}) ] ^ {2} = D (\hat {\sigma}) > 0.
$$

故选(C).

章节: 第七章 参数估计
题型: 题型一 点估计及估计量的数字特征
解析:
解析 本题考查两个参数的点估计.

(1)

$$
\begin{array}{r l} E (X) & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x; c, \theta) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {c} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot \frac {1}{\theta} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x - c}{\theta}} \mathrm{d} x \\ & \quad \xlongequal {\text {令} x - c = t} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} (c + t)   \frac {1}{\theta} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {t}{\theta}} \mathrm{d} t  , \end{array}
$$

上式可看作 $T \sim E\left(\frac{1}{\theta}\right)$ 时 $c + T$ 的期望

$$
E (c + T) = c + E (T) = c + \frac {1}{\frac {1}{\theta}} = c + \theta .
$$

而

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {E (X ^ {2}) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} f (x; c, \theta) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {c} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \bullet \frac {1}{\theta} \mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {x - c}{\theta}} \mathrm{d} x} \\ & {\qquad \frac {\text {令} x - c = t}{\theta} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} (c + t) ^ {2} \frac {1}{\theta} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {t}{\theta}} \mathrm{d} t  ,} \end{array}
$$

上式可看作 $T \sim E\left(\frac{1}{\theta}\right)$ 时 $(c + T)^2$ 的数学期望

$$
\begin{array}{r l} E (c + T) ^ {2} & = [ E (c + T) ] ^ {2} + D (c + T) = [ c + E (T) ] ^ {2} + D (T) \\ & = (c + \theta) ^ {2} + \frac {1}{\left(\frac {1}{\theta}\right) ^ {2}} = (c + \theta) ^ {2} + \theta^ {2}. \end{array}
$$

根据矩估计，令 $E(X) = \overline{X} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}X_{i},E(X^{2}) = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}X_{i}^{2}$ ，得 $c + \theta = \overline{X},(c + \theta)^2 +\theta^2 =$

$\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}X_{i}^{2}$ ，则 $\overline{X}^2 +\theta^2 = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}X_i^2$ ，进而

$$
\theta^ {2} = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i} ^ {2} - \overline {{{X}}} ^ {2}.
$$

因此，

$$
\hat {\theta} = \sqrt {\frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i} ^ {2} - \overline {{{X}}} ^ {2}},
$$

$$
\hat {c} = \overline {{{X}}} - \hat {\theta} = \overline {{{X}}} - \sqrt {\frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i} ^ {2} - \overline {{{X}}} ^ {2}},
$$

(2) 当 $x_{i} \geqslant c$ 时. $c, \theta$ 的似然函数为

$$
L (c, \theta) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f (x _ {i}; c, \theta) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {1}{\theta} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x _ {i} - c}{\theta}} = \theta^ {- n} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{\theta} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (x _ {i} - c)} = \theta^ {- n} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x _ {i} - n c}{\theta}};
$$

取对数: $\ln L(c,\theta)=-n\ln\theta-\frac{1}{\theta}\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_{i}-nc\right)$ ;

求偏导：

$$
\frac {\partial \ln L (c , \theta)}{\partial c} = \frac {n}{\theta} > 0,
$$

$$
\frac {\partial \ln L (c , \theta)}{\partial \theta} = - \frac {n}{\theta} + \frac {1}{\theta^ {2}} \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x _ {i} - n c\right),
$$

可得 $\ln L(c,\theta)$ 关于 c 单调递增. 又 $c \leqslant x_{i}$ ，从而 $\hat{c} = \min\{x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{n}\}$ .

再令 $\frac{\partial\ln L(c,\theta)}{\partial\theta} = 0$ 得

$$
\hat {\theta} = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x _ {i} - \hat {c} = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x _ {i} - \min \{x _ {1}, \dots , x _ {n} \}.
$$

于是，最大似然估计量 $\hat{c} = \min \{X_1, \dots, X_n\}, \hat{\theta} = \overline{X} - \min \{X_1, \dots, X_n\}$ .

章节: 第七章 参数估计
题型: 题型一 点估计及估计量的数字特征
题目内容:
【例题 8】总体 X 服从均匀分布 $U[\theta,3\theta]$ ，其中 $\theta>0$ 是未知参数， $X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}$ 为取自 X 的简单随机样本.

（1）求 $\theta$ 的最大似然估计量 $\hat{\theta}$ ；

(2) 求 $E(\hat{\theta}), D(\hat{\theta})$ .
解析:
解析 本题考查均匀分布的最大似然估计及估计量的数字特征.

(1) 设 $x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{n}$ 为 $X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}$ 的样本值. 当 $\theta < x_{i} < 3\theta (i = 1, 2, \cdots, n)$ 时, 由 X 的概率密度函数 $f_{X}(x; \theta) = \begin{cases} \frac{1}{2\theta}, & \theta \leqslant x \leqslant 3\theta, \\ 0, & \text{其他}, \end{cases}$ 得 $\theta$ 的似然函数为

$$
L (\theta) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f _ {X} (x _ {i}; \theta) = \left(\frac {1}{2 \theta}\right) ^ {n} = 2 ^ {- n} \theta^ {- n};
$$

取对数: $\ln L(\theta) = -n \ln 2 - n \ln \theta;$

求导数: $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\theta)}{\mathrm{d}\theta}=-\frac{n}{\theta}<0$ , 即 $\ln L(\theta)$ 关于 $\theta$ 单调减少. 又 $\theta\leqslant x_{i}\leqslant3\theta$ , 则 $3\hat{\theta}=\max\{x_{1},\cdots,x_{n}\},\hat{\theta}=\frac{1}{3}\max\{x_{1},\cdots,x_{n}\}.$

于是， $\theta$ 的最大似然估计量 $\hat{\theta} = \frac{1}{3}\max \{X_1, \dots, X_n\}$ .

(2) 设 $Y = \max\{X_{1}, \cdots, X_{n}\}$ , $\hat{\theta} = \frac{Y}{3}$ , 则 $E(\hat{\theta}) = \frac{1}{3} E(Y)$ , $D(\hat{\theta}) = \frac{1}{9} D(Y)$ .

又设 $Y=\max\{X_{1},\cdots,X_{n}\}$ 的分布函数为 $F_{Y}(y)$ ，则

$$
F _ {Y} (y) = [ F _ {X} (y; \theta) ] ^ {n} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 0, & y <   \theta , \\ \left(\frac {y - \theta}{2 \theta}\right) ^ {n}, & \theta \leqslant y <   3 \theta , \\ 1, & y \geqslant 3 \theta , \end{array} \right.
$$

$$
f _ {Y} (y) = [ F _ {Y} (y) ] ^ {\prime} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{2 ^ {n} \theta^ {n}} n (y - \theta) ^ {n - 1}, & \theta \leqslant y \leqslant 3 \theta , \\ 0, & \text {其他}. \end{array} \right.
$$

于是

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {E (Y) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y f _ {Y} (y) \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {\theta} ^ {3 \theta} y \bullet \frac {n}{2 ^ {n} \theta^ {n}} (y - \theta) ^ {n - 1} \mathrm{d} y} \\ & {\qquad \frac {\text {令} y - \theta = t}{(2 \theta) ^ {n}} \frac {n}{(2 \theta) ^ {n}} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \theta} (\theta + t) t ^ {n - 1} \mathrm{d} t = \theta + \frac {n}{n + 1} \bullet 2 \theta = \frac {3 n + 1}{n + 1} \theta ,} \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{r l} E (Y ^ {2}) & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y ^ {2} f _ {Y} (y) \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {\theta} ^ {3 \theta} y ^ {2}   \frac {n}{(2 \theta) ^ {n}} (y - \theta) ^ {n - 1} \mathrm{d} y \\ & \xlongequal {\text {令} y - \theta = t} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \theta} (\theta + t) ^ {2}   \frac {n}{2 ^ {n} \theta^ {n}} t ^ {n - 1} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {n}{2 ^ {n} \theta^ {n}} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \theta} (\theta^ {2} + 2 \theta t + t ^ {2}) t ^ {n - 1} \mathrm{d} t \\ & = \frac {n}{2 ^ {n} \theta^ {n}} \Big (\theta^ {2} \cdot \frac {2 ^ {n} \theta^ {n}}{n} + 2 \theta \cdot \frac {2 ^ {n + 1} \theta^ {n + 1}}{n + 1} + \frac {2 ^ {n + 2} \theta^ {n + 2}}{n + 2} \Big) = \frac {9 n ^ {2} + 1 5 n + 2}{(n + 1) (n + 2)} \theta^ {2}, \end{array}
$$

故

$$
E (\hat {\theta}) = \frac {1}{3} \cdot \frac {3 n + 1}{n + 1} \theta = \frac {3 n + 1}{3 n + 3} \theta ,
$$

$$
\begin{array}{r l} D (\hat {\theta}) & = \frac {1}{9} D (Y) = \frac {1}{9} \left\{E (Y ^ {2}) - [ E (Y) ] ^ {2} \right\} \\ & = \frac {1}{9} \left[ \frac {9 n ^ {2} + 1 5 n + 2}{(n + 1) (n + 2)} \theta^ {2} - \left(\frac {3 n + 1}{n + 1} \theta\right) ^ {2} \right] \\ & = \frac {4 n}{9 (n + 1) ^ {2} (n + 2)} \theta^ {2}. \end{array}
$$

章节: 第七章 参数估计
题型: 题型一 点估计及估计量的数字特征
题目内容: 【例题9】设 $X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{m}$ 与 $Y_{1}, Y_{2}, \cdots, Y_{n}$ 分别为来自总体 $X \sim N\left(\mu_{1}, \sigma^{2}\right)$ 和 $Y \sim N\left(\mu_{2}, \sigma^{2}\right)(\sigma > 0)$ 的两个独立的简单随机样本, 试求 $\mu_{1}, \mu_{2}, \sigma^{2}$ 的最大似然估计量.
解析:
解析 本题考查两个总体,多个参数的最大似然估计.

设 $x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{m}, y_{1}, y_{2}, \cdots, y_{n}$ 分别为 $X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{m}$ 与 $Y_{1}, Y_{2}, \cdots, Y_{n}$ 的样本值，则似然函数为

$$
\begin{array}{r l} L (\mu_ {1}, \mu_ {2}, \sigma^ {2}) & = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {m} f _ {X} (x _ {i}; \mu_ {1}, \sigma^ {2}) \cdot \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f _ {Y} (y _ {i}; \mu_ {2}, \sigma^ {2}) \\ & = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {m} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {(x _ {i} - \mu_ {1}) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \cdot \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {(y _ {i} - \mu_ {2}) ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \\ & = \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma}\right) ^ {m + n} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} (x _ {i} - \mu_ {1}) ^ {2} - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (y _ {i} - \mu_ {2}) ^ {2}}. \end{array}
$$

对似然函数取对数可得，

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\ln L (\mu_ {1}, \mu_ {2}, \sigma^ {2}) = - (m + n) \ln (\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma) - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} (x _ {i} - \mu_ {1}) ^ {2} - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (y _ {i} - \mu_ {2}) ^ {2}} \\ & {= - \frac {m + n}{2} \ln (2 \pi \sigma^ {2}) - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} (x _ {i} - \mu_ {1}) ^ {2} - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (y _ {i} - \mu_ {2}) ^ {2}} \\ & {= - \frac {m + n}{2 \pi} \ln (2 \pi) - \frac {m + n}{2} \ln (\sigma^ {2}) - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} (x _ {i} - \mu_ {1}) ^ {2} - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (y _ {i} - \mu_ {2}) ^ {2}.} \end{array}
$$

对 $\ln L(\mu_1, \mu_2, \sigma^2)$ 分别关于 $\mu_1, \mu_2, \sigma^2$ 求偏导并令其为零，得

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\frac {\partial \ln L (\mu_ {1} , \mu_ {2} , \sigma^ {2})}{\partial \mu_ {1}} = \frac {1}{\sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} (x _ {i} - \mu_ {1}) = \frac {1}{\sigma^ {2}} \big (\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} x _ {i} - m \mu_ {1} \big) = 0,} \\ & {\frac {\partial \ln L (\mu_ {1} , \mu_ {2} , \sigma^ {2})}{\partial \mu_ {2}} = \frac {1}{\sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (y _ {i} - \mu_ {2}) = \frac {1}{\sigma^ {2}} \big (\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} y _ {i} - n \mu_ {2} \big) = 0,} \\ & {\frac {\partial \ln L (\mu_ {1} , \mu_ {2} , \sigma^ {2})}{\partial \sigma^ {2}} = - \frac {m + n}{2 \sigma^ {2}} + \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {4}} \big [ \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} (x _ {i} - \mu_ {1}) ^ {2} + \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (y _ {i} - \mu_ {2}) ^ {2} \big ] = 0.} \end{array}
$$

从而可得 $\mu_{1}, \mu_{2}, \sigma^{2}$ 的最大似然估计量为

$$
\hat {\mu} _ {1} = \frac {1}{m} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} X _ {i} = \overline {{{X}}}, \hat {\mu} _ {2} = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} Y _ {i} = \overline {{{Y}}}, \hat {\sigma} _ {2} = \frac {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} (X _ {i} - \overline {{{X}}}) ^ {2} + \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (Y _ {i} - \overline {{{Y}}}) ^ {2}}{m + n}.
$$

章节: 第七章 参数估计
题型: 题型一 点估计及估计量的数字特征
解析:
解析 本题考查随机变量函数确定的分布的点估计.

(1) 令 $Y = X - 1$ , 由 $X$ 服从 $N(1, \sigma^2)$ , 得 $Y$ 服从 $N(0, \sigma^2)$ , 且 $Y$ 概率密度函数为

$$
f _ {Y} (y) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {y ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}}.
$$

设 $Z = |X - 1|$ 的分布函数为 $F(z)$ ，则

当 $z < 0$ 时， $F(z) = 0$ ；

当 $z \geqslant 0$ 时，

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {F (z) = P \{Z \leqslant z \} = P \{| Y | \leqslant z \} = P \{- z \leqslant Y \leqslant z \}} \\ & {\quad = \int_ {- z} ^ {z} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {y ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} y = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {z} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {y ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} y,} \end{array}
$$

从而 $Z$ 的概率密度为 $f(z;\sigma) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\frac{2}{\sqrt{2\pi}\sigma}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{z^2}{2\sigma^2}}, & z > 0,\\ 0, & \text{其它}. \end{array} \right.$

$$
\begin{array}{r l} E (Z) & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} z \cdot f (z; \sigma) \mathrm{d} z = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} z \cdot \frac {2}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} z \\ & = \frac {2 \sigma}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} \left(\frac {z ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}\right) = \frac {2 \sigma}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} = \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \sigma . \end{array}
$$

根据矩估计原理,令 $E(Z)=\overline{Z}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}Z_{i}$ , 得 $\sigma$ 的矩估计量为 $\hat{\sigma}=\sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2}}\overline{Z}$ .

(2) 设 $z_{1}, z_{2}, \cdots, z_{n}$ 为 $Z_{1}, Z_{2}, \cdots, Z_{n}$ 的样本值，则当 $z_{i} > 0 (i = 1, 2, \cdots, n)$ 时， $\sigma$ 的似然函数为

$$
L (\sigma) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f (z _ {i}; \sigma) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \frac {1}{\sigma} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {z _ {i} ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} = \left(\sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}}\right) ^ {n} \left(\frac {1}{\sigma}\right) ^ {n} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} z _ {i} ^ {2}},
$$

取对数得

$$
\ln L (\sigma) = n \ln \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} - n \ln \sigma - \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} z _ {i} ^ {2}.
$$

对 $\ln L(\sigma)$ 关于 $\sigma$ 求导，并令 $\frac{\mathrm{d}\ln L(\sigma)}{\mathrm{d}\sigma} = -\frac{n}{\sigma} + \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} z_i^2}{\sigma^3} = 0$ ，解得 $\sigma = \sqrt{\frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} z_i^2}$ ，所以 $\sigma$ 的最大似然估计量为 $\hat{\sigma} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} Z_i^2}$ .
